# AQAR Property Management Full AI Reference

## Site Identity
AQAR Property Management is Uganda-first property management software for landlords and property management firms. It is built by Chwezi Core Systems in Kampala, Uganda. The product focuses on rent operations rather than real estate listings.

AQAR helps teams replace Excel sheets, WhatsApp payment screenshots, phone follow-ups, paper files, and late landlord reports with a structured web platform for properties, units, tenants, leases, invoices, payments, proof verification, receipts, maintenance, inspections, documents, landlord remittances, and audit-aware records.

## English Positioning
AQAR is cloud property management software for Uganda and East Africa. It serves property management firms, portfolio landlords, self-managed landlords, accountants, tenants, and platform administrators.

The product is not a marketplace. It does not focus on advertising properties for sale or rent. It focuses on the operational work that happens after properties, units, tenants, leases, invoices, payments, maintenance, and landlord reporting must be managed.

## French Positioning
AQAR est un logiciel cloud de gestion immobiliere pour l Ouganda et l Afrique de l Est. Il aide les societes de gestion immobiliere, proprietaires de portefeuille, comptables, locataires et administrateurs a organiser les operations locatives.

AQAR n est pas un portail d annonces immobilieres. Le produit gere les operations : biens, unites, locataires, baux, factures, paiements, preuves, recus, maintenance, inspections, documents, rapports et versements proprietaires.

## Core Modules
Dashboard and command centre: role-specific portfolio health, occupancy, vacancies, arrears, lease expiries, unverified payments, maintenance queues, and next actions.

Property and portfolio management: portfolios, properties, sections, floors, units, occupancy state, assignments, location data, and operational status.

Tenant identity and tenancy records: tenant profiles, contact details, lease links, documents, tenancy records, and a global tenant identity concept with strict privacy boundaries.

Lease management: lease start and end dates, deposits, renewal and expiry alerts, billing rules, documents, and history.

Invoicing and payments: rent invoices, manual payment recording, payment proof submission, verification or rejection, receipts, balances, arrears, and partial payments.

Period close and remittances: management fees, deductions, landlord remittance statements, paid status, reports, and downloadable outputs.

Maintenance and inspections: maintenance requests, photos, assignments, statuses, costs, inspection templates, evidence, tenant acknowledgement, and reports.

Documents and communications: lease documents, receipts, statements, notices, reports, announcements, reminders, delivery logs, and entity-linked storage.

Security and administration: role-based access control, company isolation, support controls, subscription/admin functions, and audit trails.

Import/export: Excel onboarding and open-format exits so property managers can migrate from spreadsheet workflows.

## Ready System Scope
AQAR includes a multi-tenant SaaS foundation, super admin, property and unit management, tenant records, lease management, invoicing, payment recording, payment proof verification, maintenance, announcements, document management, period close, landlord remittances, Excel import/export, role-based access, audit trails, and Uganda-first compliance-aware workflows.

## Compliance And Security
AQAR is designed for Uganda DPPA-aware operation, with company isolation, role-aware access, audit trails, support controls, document access controls, payment history protection, tenant identity privacy boundaries, and data subject request workflows.

Important security concepts: company isolation, server-side company context, role-aware access, audit trails, controlled support access, sensitive document access controls, payment history protection, tenant identity privacy boundaries, and data subject request workflows.

## Audience
Primary commercial users are property management firms, portfolio landlords with managers, and self-managed landlords. Product users include property managers, operations managers, accountants, finance officers, landlords, tenants, support admins, and compliance reviewers.
